## Story checklist

<!-- Delete this section for code-only or data-only PRs. -->

- [ ] `status` and `date` set in `story.toml` (`draft`, or `ready` to go live on `date`)
- [ ] Open questions are listed under `open = [...]`, or there are none
- [ ] Numbers in the text match the chart CSVs
- [ ] Every source has a licence line, and nothing private or unlicensed is published
- [ ] Checked on a phone width and in the night edition

## Data checklist
